verdict.rationale: Cua documents programmatic, non-interactive control: an SDK in Python, TypeScript and Rust that creates and drives computers from code, a CLI for Cua Driver, background operation, and one-command Cua Bench runs. That supports scripted automation, but no documentation addresses headless or CI pipeline use, and a community user had to ask for an ephemeral one-shot VM mode for CI, which suggests it was not offered. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI docs or guides, ephemeral one-shot run mode, CI integration examples, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
